zones._installer_note: For EACH extra zone from the quiz, add one block keyed by a slug (e.g. 'personal', 'acme'): { label, root: 'wiki/<slug>/', index: 'wiki/<slug>/_index.md', log: 'wiki/<slug>/log.md', hot: 'wiki/<slug>/hot.md', projects_folder: 'wiki/<slug>/projects/', inbox_folder: 'wiki/<slug>/inbox/' }. Create those folders + a starter _index.md/log.md/hot.md. Mirror the zone names + switch phrases into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

switch._installer_note: Generate phrases per zone in the chosen language. Each extra zone gets to_<slug> (array of phrases) and an optional oneoff_<slug>_prefix. Always include to_work.
